profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Empower
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Backend Engineer | Collaborative Problem Solver | Strategic Thinker

As a backend engineer with over 10 years of experience, I am passionate about building systems that create meaningful value for individuals and communities. My work extends beyond writing code—it’s about designing and delivering solutions that make a tangible impact on people’s lives.

- Big Picture Thinking: I thrive on seeing how engineering contributes to larger human and community goals. I align technical solutions with meaningful outcomes, ensuring that my work serves a greater purpose.
- Initiative and Responsibility: I take pride in proactively addressing challenges and taking ownership of my work. Guided by critical thinking, I strive to move projects forward with clarity, accountability, and purpose.
- Problem Solving: I enjoy breaking down challenges, facilitating discussions, and working collaboratively to identify root causes and implement effective, lasting solutions.
- Collaborative Communication: I value clear, open communication across teams and disciplines. I find great satisfaction in aligning diverse perspectives and working together toward shared goals in a respectful and productive environment.

My ultimate goal is to contribute to projects that matter, leveraging my technical expertise and collaborative mindset to create impactful, scalable, and sustainable solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Design · Software Development · Problem Solving · Communication · Coworking · Requirements Gathering

positions.title: Cloud Engineer
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Engineered core backend components from scratch as early engineering staff (Employee #7 / Engineer #4), deploying Java/Spring-based microservices and cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP to power low-latency 8K/VR video streaming. 

• Led the company's first commercial project with KT (Korea Telecom), gathering technical requirements and collaborating with infrastructure teams to launch an 8K VR streaming service via cloud CDN integration. 
• Architected and deployed containerized CDN environments on AWS and GCP to maintain low latency and high availability for high-concurrency 8K video delivery. 
• Automated CI/CD pipelines across a distributed cluster, improving system deployment scalability and operational efficiency. 
• Mentored junior engineers on cloud operations, system architecture, and development best practices.  

Skills / Tech Stack: Java, Spring Framework, AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, CloudWatch, CloudFront), GCP, Docker, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, Nginx, Microservices, CI/CD, Makefile, Bootstrap

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.locationName: Ridgefield Park, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
(Employed via EarlyConnect as an on-site consultant for Samsung SDSA following a client technical screening) 

Specialized in Enterprise Business Software Solutions and Full-stack Engineering for Customer Management Systems (CMS).

• Led end-to-end development for Telecommunications Expense Management (TEMS v3.0), implementing RESTful APIs, responsive web UI, and automated email alerts. 
• Integrated SSO authentication with Samsung's organizational hierarchy system to enforce role-based access control (RBAC). 
• Managed multi-project delivery as Lead/PM for CommOnSDSA (Employee Community v2.0), SDSA Blog admin portals, and corporate web apps, driving client requirements and stakeholder alignment.
• Redesigned database architecture and system workflows to optimize software maintainability and performance.

Skills / Tech Stack: Java EE (J2EE), MyBatis, JSP/Servlet, JDBC, RESTful APIs, Relational Databases (Oracle/MySQL), SSO/RBAC, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML/CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Designed and developed C#/.NET and cloud-based telecom software solutions supporting E-learning and customer call services.

• Led an Interactive Voice Response (IVR) development project, engineering features for phone number purchasing, peer-to-peer calling, and automated ARS call routing. 
• Developed key backend and client-side system modules, including interactive Decision Trees, SlideShare benchmarking features, and clipboard integration. 

Skills / Tech Stack: C#, .NET MVC, Entity Framework, Twilio, WebRTC, MSSQL, Windows Azure, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML/CSS

positions.title: Web Developer (Intern)
positions.description: • Planned, designed, and developed a social networking web application using Java, Spring Framework, JSP/Servlet, MyBatis, Oracle DB, and JavaScript/jQuery.

positions.title: IS Administrator (Intern)
positions.description:
• Audited user data paths and application data storage via packet analysis and reverse engineering to establish security administration controls. 
• Developed an automated threat monitoring dashboard using RSS feeds and Google APIs.

positions.title: IT Marketer (Intern)
positions.description:
• Managed digital marketing initiatives across Facebook and Twitter, growing the company's Facebook page subscribers by 60+ within a month.
• Implemented QR code accessibility campaigns on physical property displays and business cards, enabling real-time property access for potential clients.

positions.title: Corporate Social Responsibility Assistant (Intern)
positions.description:
• Administered application intake and initial screening processes for social enterprise financial support grants. 
• Coordinated event planning and logistics for the department's annual Kick-off event and community outreach programs.

positions.title: QA Assistant (Intern)
positions.description: • Performed functional web testing, defect reporting, and user issue troubleshooting for internal education platforms.
